text:
alex (Marketing): Quick check — launch day rapid-response thread. Publish planned 11:00 PT. Need PR, growth, design, legal, product, support ready. Who's taking the live-monitoring dashboard?

sam (PR): I'll run press outreach. Sending embargo at 10:55 PT to approved list. Note: please do NOT attach raw bench data.

zoe (Growth): Paid posts queued. I'll hold 20% extra budget for 15 minutes after publish in case of traffic surge. Setting UTM tags: utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_medium=social.

lee (Design): Creative final in drive: /marketing/q2-launch/assets-v2. Uploaded an alternate hero without partner logos per legal.

marta (Legal): Confirmed: no partner logos or partner screenshots until written permissions received. Also, press kit language must avoid explicit customer revenue figures.

ian (Product): Product standby 10:30-12:30 PT. We'll watch inference latency and the KV cache hit rate. If p95 latency climbs > 30% trigger fallback policy.

clare (Support): Support staffed 10:45-12:45 PT. FAQ added to press kit: 3 bullet quick replies. Pager escalation path checked.

announce-bot: reminder scheduled: company-wide note to go at 10:40 PT to all-hands channel.

alex (Marketing): Sam — are we offering an embargos-only briefing with execs?

sam (PR): Yes, 10:58 PT briefing link in the embargo email. Exec availability: CTO available for 10 mins; CMO on standby.

zoe (Growth): For social threads: plan 11:05 PT announce, 13:00 PT data thread, 16:00 PT customer highlight. Will post variations optimized for X and LinkedIn.

lee (Design): GIFs optimized: 1200x675 for X, 1080x1080 for IG. Also prepared a short clip for LinkedIn.

marta (Legal): Small edit: remove comparative phrasing in the research quote ("faster than competitor X"). Replace with neutral phrasing.

ian (Product): Noted. I'll sign off on the product quote phrasing.

clare (Support): One ask: include a "how we measured" blurb and a short troubleshooting step for customers seeing increased latency. Saves time on first-touch replies.

alex (Marketing): Good call. Sam add methodology blurb to press kit; Lee include a screenshot showing the test harness (no partner data).

monitor-bot: health-check: synthetic user probe scheduled at 10:59 PT; will alert in #marketing-alerts on anomaly.

sam (PR): Draft embargo email (will personalize):

Hi <reporter>,
Embargoed until 11:00 PT on 2026-03-25: Redwood Inference will publish Q2 Cost & Performance snapshot with recommended optimizations for inference. We can share embargoed assets and schedule a short exec briefing at 10:58 PT.
Best,
Sam

alex (Marketing): Timeline recap: 10:40 PT internal announce, 10:55 PT embargo send, 10:58 PT reporter briefing, 10:59 PT preview checks + probe, 11:00 PT publish + social. Post any blockers here immediately.

zoe (Growth): I'll monitor clickthroughs and pause/resume ad spend from #growth if needed.

clare (Support): Channel #support-live will be primary triage; please avoid DMs for escalations.

ian (Product): If we see token queue backpressure, I'll flip a rate-limiter to protect customer SLOs.

lee (Design): Uploaded last-minute OG image tweak.

marta (Legal): I'm on standby for any quick line edits till 12:00 PT.

alex (Marketing): Emoji check: :rocket: :eyes: :white_check_mark:

sam (PR): :white_check_mark: embargo drafted

zoe (Growth): :rocket: ads ready

clare (Support): :white_check_mark: support covered

alex (Marketing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread if anything pops during the window.
